subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: What scope should issue 53600 own before implementation work starts?
rationale: The requested outcome is useful but spans multiple runtime and docs surfaces and requires a maintainer-chosen measurement environment and acceptance criteria before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: Runbook first
options.body: Document a repeatable native-Linux measurement plan and quick-win config guidance, then file focused fixes for missing spans or measured hot spots.

options.title: Split instrumentation issues
options.body: Create narrower issues for context assembly, memory_search, compaction, subagent/Telegram latency, and host metrics before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Redirect as support
options.body: Close or redirect the issue if maintainers do not want repo-owned performance analysis for a user-specific VPS configuration.

recommendation.title: Runbook first
recommendation.body: Document a repeatable native-Linux measurement plan and quick-win config guidance, then file focused fixes for missing spans or measured hot spots.

likelyOwner.reason: The current docs and runtime evidence routes through recent steipete-authored and merged work across the surfaces that would define the runbook scope.
